svg.title: Determination / פשיטות
svg.desc: Chapter 9, Hebrew pp171–173, English pp172–174. A fork ends at two options inside the established Answer frame. One option contains a check; the other remains unselected. Determination decides one of the two sides of an Ibayya. The chosen left side is illustrative, not a source rule, and this is not פשיטא or a separate Proof or Contradiction move.
